def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # A 5-line is the edge of a rectangle: copy the adjacent color pattern
    # across the rectangle, repeating it along the length of the 5-line.
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 5]
        if len(rows) >= 2 and rows == list(range(min(rows), max(rows) + 1)):
            top, bottom = rows[0], rows[-1]
            # Pattern on the right, at/below the bottom end of the line.
            seed = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][x] not in (0, 5) for x in range(c+1, w))]
            if seed:
                s0, s1 = min(seed), max(seed)
                xs = [x for x in range(c+1, w) if any(grid[r][x] not in (0, 5) for r in seed)]
                if xs:
                    for r in rows:
                        sr = s1 - ((s1-r) % (s1-s0+1))
                        for x in range(min(xs), max(xs)+1):
                            if grid[sr][x] not in (0, 5): out[r][x] = grid[sr][x]
            # A vertical color pattern on the left side is copied toward the line.
            left = [x for x in range(c) if any(grid[r][x] not in (0, 5) for r in rows)]
            if left:
                sx = min(left)
                for r in rows:
                    if grid[r][sx] not in (0, 5):
                        for x in range(sx, c): out[r][x] = grid[r][sx]
    # Transposed case: a horizontal 5-line and a vertical color pattern
    # descending from its left endpoint; replicate only within its span.
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
        if len(cols) >= 2 and cols == list(range(min(cols), max(cols)+1)):
            left, right = cols[0], cols[-1]
            seedrows = [y for y in range(r+1, h) if grid[y][left] not in (0, 5)]
            if seedrows:
                # Pattern run on the edge immediately below this barrier.
                for y in seedrows:
                    for x in range(left, right+1): out[y][x] = grid[y][left]
    return out
PY

    # Each horizontal run of 5s: extend the colored sequence below its left

    for r in range(h):
